content: Need: calibration-readiness can resolve evidence origin but cannot determine whether the evaluation suite producing results is itself trustworthy. Intent: define schema-backed Evaluation Suite Health records covering task origin, contamination, solvability, saturation, graders, harness, infrastructure, and drift ownership, and make CRD-SUITE-HEALTH executable. Context: QIF v0.6.27 remains domain-general; recent evaluation incidents show environment and harness failures can invalidate results independently of model capability. Exclude trial variance and framework learning from this release.
